items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know when I went to see Papa Celestan... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, what?

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Suit he liked, you know, that suit he liked. He didn't wear that suit too much on there. And it's on the Special Occasion, anything, he'd wear that suit, see.
I know when I went to see Papa Celestan, you know, at the way, in the bottom, yeah I think he had his Masonic cap on every day.
